papers.title: Validation of an electronic nationwide surveillance system for periprosthetic joint infections following total hip arthroplasty in Denmark

llm.relevance_to_user: 用户研究方向为髋关节植入物的生物力学与有限元分析，该论文仅涉及人工关节感染的监测系统，与生物力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or provide any implant biomechanics or FEA data; it focuses solely on epidemiological surveillance of infections.

summary_zh.motivation: 验证丹麦全髋关节置换术后假体周围感染的电子监测系统的准确性。
summary_zh.method: 利用国家登记数据验证监测系统的敏感性和特异性。
summary_zh.result: 电子监测系统能有效识别感染病例，但需要进一步优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与临床病历对照进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To validate the accuracy of an electronic nationwide surveillance system for detecting periprosthetic joint infections following total hip arthroplasty in Denmark.
summary_en.method: The surveillance system was validated by comparing its case identification against manual medical record review using national registry data.
summary_en.result: The electronic system demonstrated good sensitivity and specificity for detecting infections, though some misclassifications remained.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through clinical record review as the gold standard.
